about: Speed lab baseline (tests/amiga/run_fsuae_netbench.sh): Riptide built from main d814867, FS-UAE 3.2.35 with the tools/fs-uae libpcap bridge, AROS ROM, veth; KB/s of emulated time. See docs/COMPARISON.md section 11.

not_measured.amitcp: AmiTCP 3.0b2 crashes the AROS ROM when a program opens its bsdsocket.library; needs KICKSTART= (a real Kickstart ROM)
not_measured.roadshow: the demo needs AmigaOS 3.x (a real Kickstart and Workbench)
not_measured.miami: the evaluation version needs Kickstart 2.04+, MUI and its GUI
